description: Google Cloud offers projects, storage, virtual machines and network tools. Learn the main ideas through fictional plans and simple checks before considering any real resources. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain service accounts are workload identities
learningObjectives: Practise object versions and lifecycle rules

seo.title: Google Cloud Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Google Cloud Platform with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
